objective: Improve the additional benefit of skills, retrieved evidence and real feedback at inference time, while preserving bare-model capability.

v26.teacher_for_new_semantic_generation: Keep the separately approved local Qwen teacher; no teacher change is made by this proposal.

long_context_dataset.canonical_tokenizer: Pinned Pangolin tokenizer in the data project
long_context_dataset.canonical_release_policy: Preserve existing releases and locks. Short learner views require a separately versioned export/recipe; they are not accepted canonical 1M records.

phase_1.skill_routing: Host-selected output-contract card or explicit full skill IDs
phase_1.retrieval: Host lexical retrieval and measured document packing
phase_1.feedback_note: The current harness serializes execution/schema feedback in a user continuation. Do not relabel it as a tool message in a supposedly identical training view.
phase_1.observations: Use the exact per-call prompt, source selection, mode, native tool template and budget of the selected runtime adapter.
phase_1.validation_note: Runtime schema/format/public-test success is not independent semantic acceptance.

runtime_alignment.barbet_native: Requires a separate tested adapter matching Barbet tokenizer, tool tokens, skill position and stop tokens. The new mini/qwen API does not certify the Barbet Attention/Mamba backend.

phase_2.condition: Implement, version and test real dispatcher semantics and feedback before supervising these actions. No new tokens or autonomous router are assumed.

views.purpose: Answer tasks solvable without a skill; retain language, knowledge, literal copying and output completion.
Apply a relevant versioned procedure with necessary public intermediate results.
Ignore irrelevant or inapplicable procedures, or state genuinely missing inputs.
Change one meaningful input/negation/enum/order/unit and independently recompute the accepted target.
Use supporting spans among similar but irrelevant, outdated, contradicted or unsupported passages.
Condition on actual student failure and actual public feedback; supervise only independently accepted replacements.
Continue from an actually constructed source-bound state; retain unknowns, failed checks and remaining task requirements.
Use typed intermediate outputs when they satisfy the next procedure's preconditions; avoid unnecessary composition.
Compare audited compact/full skill representations and real evidence distance using the target tokenizer; never pad repeated prose.

sampling_proposal.unit: Unique source task families, with supervised-token exposure tracked separately; do not balance by raw expanded row count alone.
sampling_proposal.view_sampling: Views overlap across task families. Do not materialize every view for every row; cap sibling exposure and sample by diagnosed missing behaviors.
sampling_proposal.curriculum: Inside one mixed SFT: simple valid contracts and local evidence first; introduce discriminative negatives, real repair and compatible composition as validation permits. Keep retention examples throughout.
sampling_proposal.length_note: Heuristic pilot caps, measured with the target tokenizer and actual output reserve. Unsupported or mandatory-content-overbudget views fail export. This is not a change to the canonical 1M contract.

loss_contract.labels: Unshifted labels; ignored positions are -100; trainer applies the causal shift exactly once.
loss_contract.supervised: Only independently accepted assistant targets and their required terminal tokens.
loss_contract.error_context: Keep useful failed attempts as conditioning context with zero loss; do not train their erroneous actions or repeat loops.
loss_contract.template_gate: Verify actual token-boundary spans under the target template, including tool tags, thinking-mode boundaries, EOS and truncation. Reject ambiguous prefix/target alignment.
loss_contract.training_normalization: Record the reduction and denominator for loss and accumulation; compare effective supervised tokens as well as total input tokens.
loss_contract.packing: Preserve the existing no-cross-example-packing contract; no silent sequence concatenation.

admission_gates: Preserve source lineage, licenses, task semantics, root/group splits and versioned hashes.
Keep answer keys, private tests, acceptance verdicts and target-selection annotations out of model-visible prompts and retrieval indexes.
Changed task semantics require new independent verification, not blind reuse of the original answer.
Arithmetic: verify equations against the problem and numerical execution separately; executing the wrong equation is not acceptance.
Tools: check capability, literal field bindings, types, enums, omitted optional values and observation scope, not merely JSON syntax.
RAG: check entailment, entity/time/negation/units and source provenance; matching a quotation alone is insufficient.
Code: run only in the approved isolated execution subset; separate public runtime feedback from private admission tests.
Respect original first-review holds and immutable receipts; this proposal never reopens rejected source jobs.
Do not automatically convert inference traces into accepted training examples.
Audit target completeness, stop tokens, role masks, boundary alignment and actual served context budget before export.

experiment_ladder.change: B0 with only the relevant full skill text refreshed to a pinned library revision, preserving reviewed task/target semantics. B0 already has prefill; this is not a no-skill comparison.
B1 with runtime-aligned discriminative skill/evidence/contract views

evaluation.required_absolute_improvement: sft_harness must also improve over base_harness; worsening sft_bare is not evidence of better skill use.
evaluation.compute_matching: Report fixed-output-token and fixed-latency comparisons separately; also hold the document pool and available tools constant.
evaluation.training_matching: Same base revision, source-family inventory, optimizer settings and supervised-token budget; disclose different total input tokens and FLOPs from longer prefixes.
evaluation.holdout: New root/group-disjoint and near-duplicate-screened train/dev/final-test families; reserve unseen skills, compositions, tool schemas and evidence versions. Old v26/MiniCPM evaluation items are diagnosis-only.
evaluation.statistics: Paired differences with family-clustered bootstrap intervals; multiple training seeds when resources permit. Do not treat seeds, paraphrases or repeated templates as independent tasks.
evaluation.selection_window: Freeze optimizer budget and checkpoint cadence in supervised tokens before launch. Choose on development only; evaluate the selected checkpoint once on the fresh final set.
evaluation.pilot_gate: Proceed only with positive absolute harness gain and positive interaction, with intervals supporting both; no predefined retention slice may exceed its preregistered regression margin.
evaluation.rollback: Keep the previous recipe/checkpoint if absolute gain, interaction or retention gates fail. Drop only the isolated failed component; do not tune on final test.
unresolved_before_training: exact base checkpoint and training adapter
pilot supervised-token budget and checkpoint cadence
retention margins and attainable test power
